scripts.dev: npm run build -w @mat/shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @mat/server" "npm run dev -w @mat/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @mat/shared && npm run build -w @mat/server && npm run build -w @mat/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && cd desktop/src-tauri && npx tauri build
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && npm run desktop:bundle && cd desktop/src-tauri && npx tauri dev
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @mat/shared && npm run typecheck -w @mat/server && npm run typecheck -w @mat/web
